description.value: Empire Motel is a motel in Penticton situated about one and a half blocks from Skaha Lake, one of the Okanagan's popular summer beach destinations. The property features a swimming pool, BBQ area, and a courtyard, and bills itself as offering unique rooms. It sits within easy reach of Skaha Lake water sports, local fruit stands, and nearby Okanagan wineries.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is live and active (copyright 2026), confirming the motel is open. The OSM phone number (+1-250-493-2323) matches one of the two numbers listed on the website ('800 681 2323 or 250 493 2323'), and the email matches exactly. No bicycle-specific amenities (storage, laundry, tools, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags; the OSM internet_access=wlan tag cannot be confirmed from the sparse website text, so Wi-Fi is left null per the rules.
concerns: Website also lists a toll-free number (800-681-2323) not present in OSM tags.
Cached website content is very small (1555 bytes); amenities page may not have been fully captured, so several amenity fields that might otherwise be answerable remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active motel with a live website and recent OSM check date (2024-08-09); clearly publicly accessible accommodation suitable for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: swimming pool, BBQ area…one and a half blocks from Skaha Lake
